column1: # Italian (it) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context    empty (WordCraft uses no contexts yet)
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Standard Italian. Commands are second-person imperatives (Salva, Copia, Inserisci); second-person
# text uses tu; labels use sentence case; decimals use a comma (1,5); product and format names stay
# as they are (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …).
# Feature names (ribbon tabs, groups and command names) use the names Italian word-processor users
# already know, as AGENTS.md allows for feature names. Every other entry (descriptions, tooltips,
# messages, dialog text) was written from the plain meaning of the English text in ordinary
# computing vocabulary; no localisation string table or translated text was copied.
